notes: The flagged three-morpheme unit רַע בְּעֵינָיו → it displease is retained: rule 40's closing paragraph rules on this very phrase, giving it displease to רַע, בְּ and עַיִן in one unit headed on the verb while the suffix keeps the written him.
מֵעַל is one compound preposition rendered by a single from, headed on the governing opening morpheme (rule 23).
The it of see it is a supplied object with no object morpheme in the clause (rule 44).
